20+ Holiday Bingo Ideas for Christmas & Beyond

Published February 3, 2026 by MyBingoCard Team

Holiday bingo is one of the easiest, most inclusive party games you can organize during the festive season. Whether it's a classroom Christmas party, family gathering, office holiday event, or virtual celebration, bingo brings everyone together. Here are 20+ creative holiday bingo ideas organized by occasion.

Christmas Party Bingo Ideas

1. Classic Christmas Bingo

Fill squares with iconic Christmas symbols: Santa, reindeer, snowflakes, candy canes, Christmas tree, stockings, ornaments, gingerbread man, and more. This works for all ages and is especially great for kids.

2. Christmas Movie Bingo

Watch a holiday movie together and mark squares when classic movie moments happen — "someone says Merry Christmas," "snow falls," "a gift is opened," "a character sings." Works with any Christmas movie from Home Alone to Elf.

3. Christmas Carol Bingo

Feature song titles on cards. Play short clips of Christmas carols and guests mark the matching song. Who knew "Jingle Bells" vs. "Jingle Bell Rock" could cause such heated debates?

4. Ugly Sweater Bingo

Perfect for ugly sweater parties. Squares feature sweater elements: "has a reindeer," "lights that actually work," "3D elements," "has a pun," "features a cat." Guests mark squares as they spot sweaters matching each description.

5. Gift Exchange Bingo

During white elephant or Secret Santa exchanges, create bingo cards with predicted gift types: "a candle," "something handmade," "a gag gift," "a gift card," "chocolate."

Family Gathering Bingo

6. Family Traditions Bingo

Feature your family's unique holiday traditions: "Uncle Steve tells the same joke," "Grandma asks about dating life," "kids fight over dessert." Personalized and guaranteed to get laughs.

7. Holiday Dinner Bingo

Squares feature dinner table moments: "someone goes for seconds," "a dish is complimented," "someone falls asleep after eating," "a recipe is requested."

8. Multi-Generational Bingo

Design cards that work for grandparents and grandkids alike. Use large, clear text with simple holiday words and images. It's one of the rare games the whole family can genuinely play together.

Classroom Holiday Bingo

9. Holiday Vocabulary Bingo

Feature holiday-themed vocabulary words. The teacher calls out definitions and students match the word. Educational and festive at the same time.

10. Winter Science Bingo

Combine winter science concepts with bingo: "snowflake," "hibernation," "solstice," "frost," "migration." Review winter science topics in a game format.

11. Around the World Holiday Bingo

Feature how different cultures celebrate the season: "Hanukkah menorah," "Kwanzaa kinara," "Diwali lamps," "Chinese New Year dragon." A great way to teach cultural awareness.

Office Holiday Party Bingo

12. Meeting Bingo (Holiday Edition)

"Boss says 'great year,'" "someone mentions Q1 goals," "PowerPoint has a holiday theme," "someone's phone rings." Hilarious for the annual all-hands meeting.

13. Office Party Moments

"Someone eats three desserts," "IT guy DJs," "someone takes a selfie with the boss," "the intern wins a prize." Relatable workplace humor makes this a hit.

Virtual Holiday Bingo

14. Zoom Background Bingo

Feature types of virtual backgrounds: "a fireplace," "a Christmas tree," "a snowy scene," "their actual messy room." Perfect for remote holiday parties.

15. Holiday Show & Tell Bingo

Participants take turns showing a holiday item. Cards feature categories: "an ornament," "a childhood decoration," "holiday food," "an ugly sweater."

New Year's Eve Bingo

16. Countdown Bingo

Feature moments from the night: "someone makes a resolution," "midnight kiss," "confetti drops," "someone says 'new year, new me.'"

17. Year in Review Bingo

Feature major events from the past year. Call them out and guests mark what they remember. A fun trip down memory lane.
